title: EIM Town Hall / Q3 - 2026
content:
Join the whole department for the quarterly update, roadmap review and recognition awards.

I would like to invite everyone to come together so we can collectively reflect on the past quarter. It is important that we take a moment to recognize and celebrate the hard work of our award recipients. Additionally, we will use this time to echo our successes as well as the challenges and pitfalls that we can learn from moving forward.
summary: Join the whole department for the quarterly update, roadmap review and recognition awards.

title: TOGAF® Foundation program is now open for registration
content:
We are excited to announce that registration is officially open for the TOGAF Enterprise Architecture Program!

TOGAF (The Open Group Architecture Framework) is the industry-standard methodology for designing, implementing, and governing enterprise architecture. This program will equip participants with the skills to align business strategy, data, applications, and technology through a structured and proven approach

Registration : https://eim-portal.vercel.app/learning/trn-s4za58t0rz
summary: TOGAF is the industry-standard Enterprise Architecture framework that provides a structured approach for designing, implementing, and governing enterprise architecture while aligning business, data, applications, and technology.

title: Cloudera CDP Program
content:
A six-days internal training series open to every member of the department.

By the end of the program, participants will:

Master CDP Architecture → Understand hybrid deployment models and integration.

Build ETL Pipelines → Design scalable workflows using Spark, Kafka, and NiFi.

Optimize Warehousing → Run efficient queries and manage workloads with Hive/Impala.

Apply Governance → Implement SDX for compliance, lineage, and security.

Administer Clusters → Monitor, troubleshoot, and scale CDP environments.
summary: The Cloudera CDP (Cloudera Data Platform) Training Program is designed to equip data engineers, architects, and administrators with the skills to deploy, manage, and optimize Cloudera’s hybrid data platform. Participants will gain hands-on experience in managing data across cloud and on-premises environments, ensuring scalability, security, and governance.
